items.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Wins Canada Reimbursement Backing For Adult Migraine Treatment
items.summary: AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) received a recommendation from Canada's Drug Agency to reimburse UBRELVY for the acute treatment of migraine in adults. The decision follows Phase 3 trial results and a review process that included direct input from patients and clinicians. The recommendation expands access to UBRELVY in Canada and broadens AbbVie's neuroscience portfolio in migraine care. For more ideas in this area, take a look at 43 healthcare AI stocks.
